fato_historico: 1951: George VI, king of the United Kingdom, has his left lung removed in an operation after a malignant tumour was found.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to reflect on the fragility and strength of life. Just as a royal legacy once found renewal through a difficult challenge, you may find that your own endurance is greater than you imagined. It is a good time to nurture your physical vessel and consider how patience creates a foundation for long-term health and emotional vitality.
frase_do_dia: Strength is blooming quietly within you, like a four-leaf clover in the grass.
significado_numero: Representing the natural rhythm and the delicate balance of life's cycles.
conselho: Prioritize your well-being and honor your body's wisdom with gentle, restorative self-care practices.
